items.text: The data is clear: firefighters putting their lives on the line to keep us safe are at greater risk of receiving a devastating cancer diagnosis. It's past time to recognize occupational cancer as a line-of-duty injury and extend them the full federal benefits they've earned.
Tonight, don’t forget to set your clocks back an hour as Daylight Savings comes to an end. Enjoy the extra hour of sleep!

I’m proud to announce that @NYUGrossman has been awarded nearly $1,000,000 from @USDA for a health intervention program focused on nutrition and physical activity during pregnancy.

I'm grateful for @NYUGrossman's work on health outcomes for pregnant patients and young children.

I’m thrilled to have earned a 100% score from the @HSLegFund's Humane Scorecard during my first year in Congress.

As a proud animal advocate, I will always fight for the humane treatment of animals.

Hunger doesn’t take a summer vacation.

I joined @RepYvetteClarke to introduce the Summer Nutrition Parity Act that ties the summer lunch program funding to inflation so that schools have the resources to keep kids healthy and fed year-round.

I was honored to join @HSLegFund at their reception last night at the Capitol and to receive the Humane Champion Award.

I'm proud to work to advance protections and advocate for the humane treatment of animals across the country. https://t.co/8ptWrwBnib

No one should have to choose between participating in our democracy and missing a paycheck.

To make the ballot box accessible to all Americans, we must make Election Day a federal holiday. Working Americans shouldn't face extra hurdles to exercise their fundamental right. https://t.co/tK4E4rRJri

I am thrilled to have secured $643,600 for @MakorCSN and its staff to continue providing health care, residential care, and mental health treatment to Brooklynites in need.

#NY10 has incredible organizations doing amazing work and I'm honored to support them as much as possible. https://t.co/zQ8U7zBmAE

Following COVID, food insecurity in NYC is unacceptably high, with many unable to get the sustenance or nutrition they need.

I was honored to deliver an $175,000 grant to expand @RethinkFood's cutting edge food pantry program that connects New Yorkers with nutritious meals. https://t.co/HhMv7CQ3a4

Pro-”life” Republicans would rather let children die than allow women to exercise their reproductive freedoms.

The GOP war on women shows no signs of stopping.

Congress must act to protect reproductive freedom for all.

⁨Thank you to everyone who joined us for our Summer Nutrition Townhall yesterday.

We will continue to work to ensure that food insecurity – especially in the summer – is something no family or child has to deal with.⁩ https://t.co/iuZ8IAGtQl

Yesterday's subway incident only further highlights the urgent need for expanded access to mental health services in NYC.

@RepMalliotakis and I introduced the Michelle Go Act to do just that. We must ensure it passes so those who need mental health treatment can get it.

Last year New York City refunded nearly $30 million in stolen SNAP benefits. That authority expires at the end of September.

We cannot allow fraudsters to deprive New Yorkers of the nutrition they need.

I am fighting to ensure Congress extends this lifeline to working families. https://t.co/DqOXMEZguW

Sixty years ago, the Food Stamp Act founded the food nutrition program now known as SNAP.

Today, one in seven New Yorkers rely on SNAP to put food on their table.

Despite Rs constant attempts to cut SNAP, I will always fight to expand and protect this essential program.

For nearly 60 years, @ProjectRenewal’s 3rd Street Men’s Shelter has helped New Yorkers with substance abuse problems work towards sobriety, housing, and employment.

We must continue to support their work, including by expanding Medicaid to cover this type of treatment. https://t.co/DwDRaADsOK

Any doctor will tell you that early cancer screenings and treatment save lives, which is why it’s so important that we expand Medicare coverage to include blood-based screenings for older New Yorkers.

Thank you @RepTerriSewell for leading the charge.

From tackling gun-building tutorials on kids’ social media feeds to fighting to expand Medicaid coverage of lifesaving cancer screenings, I spent this week working hard to protect the health and safety of New Yorkers. https://t.co/iecrxoXutp

☀️ ⏰ Don’t forget: daylight saving time ends tonight at 2am.

Make sure to set your clocks back an hour as we “fall back” (and get another hour of sleep!).

My office organized a Senior Wellness Door Knocking Day with @NYCHA Family Partnership and local elected official offices to check in on our older adult neighbors & provide resources. I am thankful to LES Infill I President Diana Aldahondo for her leadership here. https://t.co/otLL4N09N8

32 years ago, @BillClinton signed the Family & Medical Leave Act, securing protected leave for family or medical reasons.

As Trump weakens labor protections, the FMLA safeguards workers balancing work and family.

We must expand coverage so Americans can care for their loved ones.

I joined @RepDonBeyer in urging the NIH Acting Director to resist EOs that jeopardize public health and disrupt lifesaving research.

These delays cost lives, harm innovation, and disproportionately impact critical research and delivery of care at the nation’s hospitals and universities.

https://t.co/hJZ37MHUqb

I joined @RepEspaillat in introducing the Protecting Sensitive Locations Act to stop ICE raids in schools, hospitals, and other essential places.

No one should fear ICE while seeking education or care.

I’ll keep fighting to protect immigrant communities from this intimidation.

70M Americans receive Medicaid–including 39% of children.

In #NY10, 221K Medicaid recipients would see their coverage eviscerated.

41% of NY children receive insurance through Medicaid. This budget would slash their benefits, along with 60% of all seniors in NY nursing homes.

In #NY10, 12,000 people who purchase health insurance through an ACA marketplace would see their premiums rise by nearly $3k—a 48% increase.

At a time of rising costs and an affordability crisis, the GOP is gutting every government program that makes health care affordable.

Over 72 million children, families, and seniors depend on Medicaid for vital health care coverage. Over one in five Americans.
 
The GOP’s Medicaid cuts are an attack on our most vulnerable.
 
Democrats stand uniformly opposed to their cruelty. https://t.co/pHGclGhYLL
